_comment: Sitting 15: AI interface URL policy gate (UrlPolicy::ValidateAiInterfaceUrl) — http:// is loopback-only AND never with key_name.  This fixture exercises three rejection categories at config-load: (a) non-loopback http:// (numeric IPv4 literal so the test doesn't depend on DNS), (b) credentialed plaintext (loopback http:// + key_name), (c) forbidden scheme (ws://).  Each rejection emits a LOG_CORE_ERROR + the rejected entry is dropped from m_ApiInterfaces.  A control https:// interface is included so ConfigChecker accepts the config (otherwise the engine exits with no usable interface).  Expected counter deltas: url_policy_rejections += 2, credentialed_plaintext_http_rejections += 1.
